title: Greenville Run Club (Monday nights)
recurrence: Every Monday, 6:45 PM (meets at The Commons / Pangaea Brewing)
description: Social run (300+ people in summer) to Cancer Survivors Park and back, then hangs at the brewery. No signup, just show up. Check Instagram for winter schedule changes.

title: Running for Brews 5K Social Run (Tuesday nights)
description: Free 3-mile run/walk from the brewery, then beers. RSVP on Meetup.

title: Fleet Feet Pub Run (Thursday nights)
description: Free weekly 3.1-mile run or walk starting from a different brewery each week. Check the Fleet Feet page or Facebook group for this week's location.

title: Southernside Brewing Trivia Night (Wednesdays)
description: Weekly trivia on the patio. Teams of up to 6; show up by 6:45 to grab a table.

title: Christ Church Young Adults (23-39) - Third Thursdays
recurrence: Third Thursday of each month, 5:30 PM
description: Monthly social for young adults plus quarterly service projects.
